newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends slightly firmer in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends slightly firmer in quiet market.

text.p: NWE gasoline was slightly firmer on Friday in a fairly quiet end-of-the-week market, traders said.
Eurograde barges traded at around $198.50 fob ARA for pre-May 10 delivery in early trade, while regular barges traded at $190 and $189.50 fob ARA.
Traders said very prompt Eurograde material was talked around the $194/$195 fob ARA level.
Some traders attributed the lack of trade to low water levels on the Rhine between Basel and Frankfurt which meant barges could only take half loads at the moment.
"This is making barges scarce and also discouraging some players from moving stuff due to the high freight rates," said one trader.
"I would have thought low water levels would have stirred up activity with people buying material now in case the situation got much worse," countered another trader.

There was talk that a couple of players could be planning to exert a squeeze on the market in May, but a number of traders said such a move would have limited success given the lack of European material seen moving to the United States at the moment.
"There must be some 100,000 tonnes been held in the storage in ARA at the moment," said one trader. -- Melanie Goodfellow, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
